text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Voices placed great expectations on Ines 
Fujin for the Satsuki Sho. One of 
them—"Because I wanted to dream"—lingered 
in her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Around that time, words of encouragement 
arrive from her younger twin sisters, who 
are surely practicing hard at dancing. 
Naturally, this fires Ines Fujin right up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho had arrived. 
With Ines Fujin drawing more and more 
attention, there would surely be many 
Umamusume keeping a close eye on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among them was her friend, Mejiro Ryan. 
Sparks flew as the two fueled their 
rivalry. The curtain was about to rise on 
a fiery Satsuki Sho!
